name: testing
description: Testing utilities for unit tests.  Provides assertion functions for writing test cases. Tests are defined using the `test` keyword and assertions check that conditions are met.  @example use testing  test "addition works" {     2 3 + 5 testing::assert_eq }

functions.name: assert_eq
functions.description: Assert that two values are equal. Works with any type (i64, f64, str, ptr).

functions.name: assert_false
functions.description: Assert that a value is falsy. Falsy means: zero for integers, zero for floats, empty for strings, null for pointers.

functions.name: assert_ne
functions.description: Assert that two values are not equal. Works with any type (i64, f64, str, ptr).

functions.name: assert_true
functions.description: Assert that a value is truthy. Truthy means: non-zero for integers, non-zero for floats, non-empty for strings, non-null for pointers.

functions.name: fail
functions.description: Unconditionally fail a test with a message.
